game.title: KEPPER: Code Islands
game.subtitle: Build a program and watch KEPPER bring it to life across floating islands.

1.title: First steps
1.description: Guide KEPPER to the glowing portal. Commands run from top to bottom.
1.hint: The starter already moves once. Add two more Move commands.

2.title: The bend
2.description: Take the turn and reach the portal. Repeat can save you from writing Move again and again.
2.hint: Move twice, turn right, then move twice more.

3.title: Two possible roads
3.description: One program must win on both maps. Check whether the tile ahead is blocked.
3.hint: The clear road runs east. On the blocked map, go north first, then east along the upper path.

4.title: Find the bug
4.description: The starter program has wrong turns. Fix it so KEPPER reaches the portal.
4.hint: After the first Move, the path turns right, then left, then right again.

5.title: Crystal crossing
5.description: Collect the gold crystal before reaching the portal. The same program must work on both maps.
5.hint: Use If blocked to choose a route. The long route goes north twice and east four times; the clear route stays straight.

game.codeHelp: Commands: move, left, right, repeat 2 { … }, if blocked { … } else { … }. No browser code is executed.
game.runTip: Press Run to test every map. Ctrl+Enter also works.
game.syntaxError: Check the command on line {{line}}. Use the game commands shown below the editor.
game.unavailable: This command unlocks on a later island.

failures.crystal: Map {{scenario}}: collect the gold crystal before entering the portal.
failures.unfinished: Map {{scenario}}: KEPPER stopped before reaching the portal.
failures.limit: Map {{scenario}}: the program ran too long. Shorten the loop.
